title: DeadlineMilestoneEvent
description: Published to deadlines.milestone by the Acompanhamento context (apps/data-deadline-tracker) when an open, eligible incident crosses 25/50/75/100% of its current OLA, or the separate abandoned threshold. Carries what was known about the incident at that instant, never its final outcome — after this track, the (incident × marco) unit Predição trains on. A severity change recalculates the milestones on the new deadline instead of continuing the old one; a milestone already emitted for a given kind never fires again for the same incident. See domain/ubiquitous-language.md#marco.

external_id.description: Together with tenant_id and source, identifies the incident this milestone is about — same identity as incident-alert.schema.json.

kind.description: pct_100 constats the breach; no further pct_* milestone follows it for this incident. abandoned is a separate axis — its own threshold, past pct_100, for an incident that stayed open far beyond its deadline.

severity.description: Severity in effect at the instant this milestone fired — may differ from the incident's severity at open, if it was recategorized.

acknowledged_at.description: As known at the instant this milestone fired.

due_at.description: opened_at plus the deadline for the severity in effect at this instant — recalculated whenever severity changes, never continued from a prior severity's deadline.

deadline_seconds.description: The tenant's configured deadline for severity, at this instant.

consumed_ratio.description: Elapsed time over deadline_seconds at this instant. Can exceed 1.0 — that is what drives pct_100 and, further out, abandoned.

occurred_at.description: When the tracker detected and emitted this milestone — assigned, not derived from the incident's own timestamps.
